t: A 3D-printed Mars-style rover you build yourself around an ESP32.
steps: Download the STL files, wiring diagrams, and code from the project's GitHub page.
Pick the standard rover or the Mini and gather the parts list from the README.
Print the chassis in PETG or PLA and the tires in TPU.
Wire the ESP32, motor drivers, and power converters by following the Fritzing diagrams.
Install the Arduino IDE and the ESP32 board package.
Upload the Wi-Fi firmware sketch to the ESP32.
Run the Python desktop controller or the Android app and drive with a gamepad.
Use the hex rims with brass adapters to keep the wheels from slipping.
